meta.title: DEEPTIME — the far-future universe dataset
meta.note: Procedural ~50 Gyr universe on the cosmos log-radial scale, extended ×1.62 (accelerating expansion). Positions normalised to R = cmbR × extension. Objects/events/regions link to the QTR codex.
